@graph.name: Cyanophage CP12 remodels the Prochlorococcus MED4 dark complex: MD trajectories and analyses
@graph.description: Molecular dynamics of the Prochlorococcus MED4 GAP2-CP12-PRK dark complex with host or cyanophage P-HM2 CP12, reduced and oxidized, 3 x 100 ns GROMACS replicates each, plus a 1,012-system cysteine PTM set per variant. A detached manifest as it would sit in the LAMBDA tenant of the BER Data Lakehouse: the bytes stay on Zenodo, EMSL and MassIVE, and the rigorous metadata travels as a lambda-ber-schema record beside this file.

@graph.name: MED4 dark complex, reduced (0000)
@graph.description: System 0000: all cysteines reduced, no modification. Host gap2, host prk and host (med4) cp12. Solvent stripped from the released trajectories.

@graph.name: MED4 dark complex, oxidized (0003)
@graph.description: System 0003: disulfides on CP12 and PRK, no other modification (oxidized reference). Host gap2, host prk and host (med4) cp12. Solvent stripped from the released trajectories.

@graph.name: MED4 cysteine PTM combinatorial set (1,012 systems)
@graph.description: 46 GAP2 states x 11 PRK states x 2 CP12 states = 1,012 systems, including 0000 and 0003. GAP2 Cys20/78/157/161: reduced or SNO/SOH/SSG on any non-empty subset; PRK Cys201/225: reduced, disulfide, or SNO/SOH/SSG; CP12: reduced or disulfide. Each state is applied identically to every chain of that subunit. One sample row stands for all 1,012 because the schema has no way to enumerate variants compactly. Sulfenylation (SOH) and disulfide have no PTMTypeEnum term.

@graph.name: HM2 dark complex, reduced (0000)
@graph.description: System 0000: all cysteines reduced, no modification. Host gap2 and host prk with the cyanophage p-hm2 cp12 in place of the host cp12. Solvent stripped from the released trajectories.

@graph.name: HM2 dark complex, oxidized (0003)
@graph.description: System 0003: disulfides on CP12 and PRK, no other modification (oxidized reference). Host gap2 and host prk with the cyanophage p-hm2 cp12 in place of the host cp12. Solvent stripped from the released trajectories.
